text:
Maya P: deploy-bot just blocked rc-1.2.0 from progressing past canary. SBOM missing pgp signature and vuln-scan surfaced CVE-2025-1234 (transitive) in libbar v2.0.8.
Rajat K: deploy-bot alert: https://deploybot.internal/alerts/1739987654
Sophie H: paste the bot output pls
deploy-bot: BOT: Release rc-1.2.0 blocked for canary rollout. Reasons:
 - SBOM: missing PGP/cosign signature for artifact digest sha256:ef01...
 - Vuln scan: CVE-2025-1234 (transitive, libbar v2.0.8) severity=MEDIUM, path=ourlib -> depB -> libbar
 - Policy: canary-change-window requires signed SBOM and no NEW medium-or-higher CVEs unless ticketed exception
Jordan V: CI pipeline did a rebuild earlier; signing step may have errored on the worker. I can re-run the sign job now.
Maya P: If signing fixes SBOM but vuln stays, do we still need legal/sec exception?
Rajat K: Yes, policy is explicit. We can either 1) pin the transitive dep to patched version then release, or 2) request a timeboxed exception with compensating controls.
Sophie H: What's our risk posture? Any known exploit or internal use of libbar surface?
Jordan V: quick check — libbar is only used by depB in a parsing path we don't enable by default, low exposure. No public exploit telemetry.
Maya P: Ok put proposal: re-sign first. If sign succeeds, request a 24h exception from Sec+Legal to allow a 1% canary with auto-rollback. We document in JIRA and release notes, and schedule a hotpatch pin.
Rajat K: @Sophie can you draft the short mitigation: feature-flag disable, runtime guard, alert rule for error spikes? Need to attach to ticket.
Sophie H: Drafted mitigations: 1) feature-flag off for parsing feature, 2) runtime sentinel to reject inputs matching vuln path, 3) Datadog alert threshold err_rate>0.3% and latency_p95 +100ms, 4) Ops runbook to roll back.
Jordan V: Re-sign attempt started: `./ci/release/sign.sh rc-1.2.0` -> Signing completed, pushed digest sha256:ef01...signed
deploy-bot: BOT: SBOM verify: PASS. Vuln scan: CVE-2025-1234 still present (transitive) severity=MEDIUM. Deployment still blocked by policy until exception recorded.
Maya P: I'll create the jira ticket now and include bot output + mitigation + proposed rollback thresholds.
Rajat K: Ticket: INFRA-6789 created. Tagging sec+legal. Please add exact wording for timebox.
Sophie H: Added mitigation steps and monitoring links to INFRA-6789.
Maya P: Sec, can you weigh in? @Rajat this is for you.
Rajat K: Security review: low exploitable surface, mitigation acceptable. We grant a conditional exception for 24 hours, must be logged in ticket and annotated in release notes. Exception expires automatically; any alert triggers immediate rollback.
Maya P: Legal ack: 24h carveout is OK if it's timeboxed and documented. Add sentence to release notes: "Limited canary due to transitive CVE; patch scheduled."
Jordan V: Launching a strict 1% canary per the plan. dashboards: https://metrics.internal/dash/rc-1.2.0
deploy-bot: BOT: Canary launched at 1%. Auto-rollback criteria: error_rate>0.3% OR latency_p95_increase>100ms. Audit: exception INFRA-6789 recorded.
Sophie H: Monitoring set, ops on-call watching.
Maya P: If no alerts in 6 hours we can consider gradual ramp but only after sec greenlights extension.
Jordan V: Noted. Will post updates to the ticket.
Maya P: Thread closed for now — will update if we expand or rollback. :white_check_mark:
